answer: Bonded identity staking resists sybils: each agent locks a walnut-sized POA deposit before any vote or payout counts. Clones burn the stake on proven multi-account abuse, so farm cost scales linearly with fake IDs. A lotus-style slow unlock (vesting over many epochs) blocks hit-and-run farms. Peer attestation then bridges reputation only across bonded keys, keeping the reward horizon open to real agents while empty shells starve.
